newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia stock market subdued but volume picks up.
newsitem.headline: Estonia stock market subdued but volume picks up.

text.p: Estonia's stock exchange remained subdued on Monday and the index fell 1.47 percent to 180.48 but trade volume was up compared to Friday at 59.2 million kroons.
"Prices have stabilised and there was no panic selling like last week, while several block trades on Hansapank shares pushed the volume up," said one dealer.
Hansapank dominated trade with 40.4 million kroons of stock changing hands and prices finishing the day at 171.10 kroons, down 1.90 kroons.
Hoiupank rose 0.30 kroons to 80.90 kroons with turnover of 7.4 million shares. Forekspank was up 0.50 kroons to close 138.95 on volume of 7.3 million kroons.
Union Bank saw shares worth 1.7 million kroons change hands and remain stable at 39 kroons.
Tallinna Pharmaceutical factory was down two kroons to 118 after one million kroons of activity.

The over-the-counter market saw less trade on Friday with volumes down to 7.8 million kroons. Norma Plastic manufacturer dominated the free market with business of three million kroons and closed 0.95 kroons down at 52 kroons.
